children: The Debt Management Office sale of 900 million pounds ($1.2 billion) in the September 2049 index-linked gilt due at 0900 GMT is expected to attract demand given the gilt's strong performance over the past year, RBC Capital Markets strategists say in a note. "The price action is clearly indicative of strong demand for the bond/sector and hence we expect the auction to go fine." In addition, index-linked gilts look more attractive than nominal gilts, given slow U.K. economic growth and elevated energy costs which helped lift 10-year and 30-year nominal gilt yields to multiyear highs this week, they say. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
